merge_lora_weights: merge LoRA adapter weights into a base Llama model and save the merged model to an output directory
run_merge_lora_cli: run the merge_lora_weights script via CLI with base_model, peft_model, and output_dir arguments
merge_peft_model: merge a PEFT LoRA fine-tuned model back into the base LlamaForCausalLM using merge_and_unload
save_merged_model: save the merged Llama model and tokenizer to a specified output directory after merging LoRA weights
load_peft_model: load a base Llama model and apply a PEFT LoRA adapter using PeftModel.from_pretrained
